ContinueOnCalibrationError.label: Continue on a calibration error
ContinueOnCalibrationError.help: Whether a calibration error stops the trade build.
ContinueOnCalibrationError.description: When it is true, the build does not fail when a model misses its calibration tolerance. It logs a warning and prices the trade anyway. Leave it false when a calibration miss must be visible, as in a validation run.
ContinueOnCalibrationError.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

AllowModelFallbacks.label: Allow model fallbacks
AllowModelFallbacks.help: Whether a missing market object uses a fallback.
AllowModelFallbacks.description: When it is true, a model build that misses a market object does not fail. The build uses a fallback instead, such as a zero volatility surface when the surface is missing. The price then rests on the fallback, so read it with care.
AllowModelFallbacks.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

Calibrate.label: Calibrate
Calibrate.description: When it is false, model calibration is off. A person does not normally set it: ORE uses it for its own workflows that do not need a calibration.
Calibrate.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

GenerateAdditionalResults.label: Generate additional results
GenerateAdditionalResults.help: Whether the engines produce results beyond the NPV.
GenerateAdditionalResults.description: When it is false, the engines that support it do not produce their additional results. ORE sets it false for a run that needs only the NPV, as in a sensitivity or a stress, to save time.
GenerateAdditionalResults.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

RunType.label: Run type
RunType.help: The kind of run the portfolio is built for.
RunType.description: One of NPV, SensitivityDelta, SensitivityDeltaGamma, Stress, Exposure, Capital, TradeDetails, PortfolioAnalyser, HistoricalPnL, BondSpreadImply or AbsMaturityUpdate. ORE sets it from the context. Some engines change what they compute to suit it, such as a first order pnl expansion for a sensitivity run.
RunType.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

McType.label: Monte Carlo type
McType.help: The kind of Monte Carlo the run uses.
McType.description: One of Classic or American. ORE sets it from the context in which the pricing engine file is used. Some trade constructions change what they attach to suit it.
McType.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

StrikeSpread.label: Strike spread
StrikeSpread.help: The strike spread that replication engines use.
StrikeSpread.description: It overrides the default value a replication engine uses to compute the strike spread of a replication portfolio.
StrikeSpread.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

BondFutureAmericanAsEuropean.label: American bond future as European
BondFutureAmericanAsEuropean.help: Whether an American bond future option is priced as European.
BondFutureAmericanAsEuropean.description: It takes true, false or a regular expression. When it is true, every American bond future option is priced as though its exercise were European. When it is a regular expression, only the options whose underlying contract name matches it are. When it is false, the default, it has no effect.
BondFutureAmericanAsEuropean.reason: The guide documents it in its global parameters section, and the ORE source reads it.

PseudoCurrency.TreatAsFX.label: Pseudo-currency: treat as FX
PseudoCurrency.TreatAsFX.help: Whether the pseudo-currency market is treated as an FX market.
PseudoCurrency.TreatAsFX.description: It passes through to the pure FX handling of the pseudo-currency. With no global parameters, ORE treats the pseudo-currency as FX.
PseudoCurrency.TreatAsFX.reason: The guide does not document it; the ORE source reads it when it builds the pseudo-currency market.

PseudoCurrency.BaseCurrency.label: Pseudo-currency base currency
PseudoCurrency.BaseCurrency.help: The currency the pseudo-currency quotes against.
PseudoCurrency.BaseCurrency.description: It names the base currency of the pseudo-currency market, usually USD.
PseudoCurrency.BaseCurrency.reason: The guide does not document it; the ORE source reads it when it builds the pseudo-currency market.

PseudoCurrency.FXIndexTag.label: Pseudo-currency FX index tag
PseudoCurrency.FXIndexTag.help: The tag ORE uses when it asks for an FX correlation.
PseudoCurrency.FXIndexTag.description: It is the tag of the FX index, such as GENERIC, so ORE requests a correlation named FX-GENERIC-USD-EUR rather than one named for a real currency pair.
PseudoCurrency.FXIndexTag.reason: The guide does not document it; the ORE source reads it when it builds the pseudo-currency market.

PseudoCurrency.Curve.XAU.description: It maps the three-letter code XAU to the curve that prices it, such as PM:XAUUSD.
PseudoCurrency.Curve.XAU.reason: The guide does not document it; the ORE source reads it when it builds the pseudo-currency market.

PseudoCurrency.DefaultCorrelation.label: Pseudo-currency default correlation
PseudoCurrency.DefaultCorrelation.help: The correlation to use when the market has none.
PseudoCurrency.DefaultCorrelation.description: It is optional. When it is set, ORE uses it when the market holds no correlation for the pseudo-currency.
PseudoCurrency.DefaultCorrelation.reason: The guide does not document it; the ORE source reads it when it builds the pseudo-currency market.

ImplyAbsMaturityForRegex.label: Imply absolute maturity for a trade id
ImplyAbsMaturityForRegex.help: A regular expression on trade ids whose maturity ORE implies.
ImplyAbsMaturityForRegex.description: The ORE examples set it to a regular expression on trade ids. The ORE source in this checkout does not read it, so a configuration that carries it round-trips unchanged and the run ignores it. Treat it as a parameter ORE does not document.
ImplyAbsMaturityForRegex.reason: The ORE examples set it, but the ORE source in this checkout does not read it. Treat it as undocumented.
ImplyAbsMaturityForRegex.source_ref: the ORE examples carry the parameter, and the ORE source in this checkout does not read it
